BrochureContent.Content:
Steeplewood is an exceptional detached Edwardian residence of outstanding character, set amidst approximately 1.2 acres of beautifully landscaped mature gardens. Combining timeless period elegance with carefully considered modern enhancements, this distinguished home offers a rare blend of architectural heritage, generous proportions and contemporary family living.

Originally constructed circa 1900 and sympathetically extended over the years, Steeplewood retains the charm and craftsmanship synonymous with the Edwardian era.

The home showcases elegant architectural proportions complemented by exquisite Arts and Crafts detailing, including a striking timber staircase, beautifully crafted fireplaces and a wealth of original period features.

Extending to approximately 495 sq.m / 5,330 sq.ft, the accommodation is both substantial and versatile, with a natural flow between the principal reception spaces, creating an exceptional environment for both family life and entertaining. A welcoming entrance porch leads into a beautifully appointed reception hall, where a deep bay window with built-in window seat captures views over the gardens and fills the space with natural light. This leads through to an impressive drawing room, a wonderfully bright and elegant reception space featuring large picture windows, polished timber floors and original period fireplaces.

A particular highlight of Steeplewood is the recently completed kitchen and breakfast room extension, architecturally designed by Andrew Lohan to combine contemporary design with the character of the original residence. This exceptional addition creates a spectacular light-filled living space that sits in harmony with the period architecture while offering every convenience for modern family life. The bespoke Porter and Jones cabinetry, extensive work surfaces and generous central island provide both style and functionality, while expansive glazing and strategically positioned rooflights draw in natural light and frame views across the surrounding gardens. Direct access to the patio further enhances the connection between the interior and the landscaped grounds.

The original bespoke kitchen, with its classic black-and-white tiled floor, granite worktops and traditional Aga, remains a charming feature of the home and connects seamlessly with the extended living area. The ground floor is further complemented by an additional reception room, a well-appointed utility room and guest WC, providing excellent flexibility for modern living.

The upper floors offer an impressive arrangement of bedroom accommodation. The principal suite occupies its own private wing and includes a generous dressing room, walk-in wardrobe and luxurious en suite bathroom complete with a cast-iron bath. Access to a private balcony provides a wonderful vantage point with views towards the Dublin Mountains. A beautifully appointed library/study, also opening onto its own balcony, offers a peaceful retreat overlooking the gardens.

A further reception room/family room on the first floor provides additional versatility and could readily serve as an extra bedroom if required. Five further bedrooms and three additional bathrooms are arranged across the upper floors, creating an ideal layout for family living and visiting guests.

The gardens at Steeplewood are a defining feature of the property. Designed by renowned landscape designer Martin Brady, the grounds have been thoughtfully arranged with expansive lawns, mature trees and carefully considered planting, creating a wonderfully private and tranquil setting. A charming garden house, designed to complement the main residence, provides an additional outdoor retreat, while the extensive grounds offer both privacy and scope for further enjoyment.

Perfectly suited to family life, Steeplewood offers exceptional space, privacy and flexibility, while being ideally located close to some of South Dublin's most sought-after schools and amenities.

Situated on Killiney Avenue, one of South Dublin's most prestigious residential addresses, the property enjoys a superb coastal setting close to Killiney Hill, the seafront and the vibrant villages of Dalkey and Glasthule. Dalkey village, with its charming high street, offers an excellent selection of boutiques, cafés, restaurants and traditional pubs. The nearby DART provides convenient access to Dublin city centre, while the M50 is easily accessible, ensuring excellent connectivity.

Steeplewood presents a rare opportunity to acquire a substantial Edwardian residence of architectural distinction, where period grandeur, contemporary refinement and a magnificent coastal location combine to create a truly exceptional family home.

• Exceptionally handsome Edwardian Arts and Crafts period residence
  • Prestigious, highly regarded residential address in the heart of Killiney
  • Standing on gardens of approximately 1.2 acres that have been meticulously maintained and creates a sense of peace and tranquillity designed by Martin Brady
  • Magnificent views of the surrounding landscape
  • Substantial detached garden room with many versatile uses
  • Within walking distance of Killiney Beach and DART station
  • Accommodation extending to approximately 495 sq.m (5,330 sq.ft)
  • Many period embellishments of the era intact including ceiling coving and period fireplaces
  • Off street parking for a number of cars securely positioned behind electric gates
  • Excellent access to the N11, M50, LUAS and airport with the Aircoach
  • Surrounded by a wide range of primary and secondary schools, churches and the popular tranquil scenic walks by the seafront and over Dalkey and Killiney hills
  • Gas fired central heating
  • Located within the Dun Laoghaire Rathdown Architectural Conservation Area
  • Porter & Jones kitchen with high end integrated appliances
  • Andrew Lohan designed breakfast room extension flooded in natural light
  • Wraparound feature verandas benefitting from the stunning views of the St Alphonus church steeple and the Dublin Mountains
